summary: iter374 frontend UI E2E testing for Admin Landing Page Builder. Login as super_admin, list view + editor tabs (Settings/HTML/Preview), Tab-key-to-spaces in CodeArea, Save/Publish/Unpublish round-trip, device+language preview toggles, header/footer switch reflected in DraftPreview iframe, slug validation, and sidebar Marketing entry navigation — all verified. Two issues surfaced: (1) CodeArea text color is dark-on-dark (contrast bug) due to global CSS override; (2) Non-admin credentials in review request returned 401 so the admin-gate could not be verified end-to-end via that account (backend gate itself is not in scope for retest).

ui_bugs.issue: Textarea text color is rgb(30,41,59) (slate-800) on rgb(2,6,23) (slate-950) background — dark-on-dark, nearly invisible. Root cause: global rule 'html:not(.dark) textarea { color: #1e293b; }' in /app/frontend/src/index.css line 2919 overrides Tailwind class 'text-slate-100' on the raw <textarea>. Impact: admin cannot see the HTML/CSS/JS they are typing in light-mode. Fix: force color inline (style={{color:'#f1f5f9'}}) or add '!important' via a class specific to CodeArea, or bump specificity (e.g. `textarea.code-area { color: #f1f5f9 !important; }`).

issues: iframe sandbox uses both 'allow-scripts' AND 'allow-same-origin' — browser warns this can escape sandboxing. For draft admin previews (same-origin admin session) this is intentional but flag for hardening; consider dropping allow-same-origin since custom JS runs in a fresh document without needing top-window access.

rca of the issue: CodeArea contrast RCA — The CodeArea component in AdminLandingPageEditor.jsx sets className with Tailwind utilities 'bg-slate-950 text-slate-100'. However index.css contains a legacy global 'html:not(.dark) textarea { color: #1e293b; }' (line 2919) intended to enforce readable text on white inputs in light mode. Because CSS specificity is equal (single class vs single element), the later-loaded index.css rule wins over Tailwind's .text-slate-100, giving slate-800 text on the slate-950 dark background — near-invisible. Reproduction: (1) login as admin, (2) navigate to /admin/landing-pages/new, (3) click HTML Editor tab, (4) start typing in English HTML textarea → text is barely visible. Mitigation options: (a) inline style color:'#f1f5f9' on the CodeArea textarea, (b) add '!important' via a scoped CSS rule, (c) refactor the global textarea color to only apply to textareas without a dark background utility class.
